name: riff-connect-hermes
description: Riff Connect for Hermes: a small Worker on your own Cloudflare account that lets Riff reach your Hermes agent, with no tunnel and no open port.

PAIRING_CODE.description: The pairing code from Riff › Models › Add › **Hermes agent, through Riff Connect** › *Make and copy a code*. Paste it here; Riff uses it once to pair. Setting up by hand? Any random code of 12 characters or more works (for example from `openssl rand -hex 16`).
